narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec scan of `deftai/directive` @ **`0c9f6ab`** (2026-09-06). Filed set: **2 HIGH + 1 MEDIUM (new)**.

Under **active UAT with empty grants**, `cp` and plain `>` / `&>` deny, but three remaining gaps still allow mutation:

1. Bash **`&>|` / `&>>|`** redirect dests are not harvested (`>` and `&>` deny; these both-stdout/stderr noclobber synonyms fail open). Distinct from reported `>|` / `>&` / `>!`.
2. Residual dest-form writers (`mysqldump` / `mysqlpump` / `mariadb-dump` / `PlistBuddy` / `virt-copy-out` / `virt-tar-out` / `gobjcopy` / `dcfldd` / `dd_rescue` / `sdd` / `ibtool` / `afconvert` / `actool` / `momc`) still plant `.deft/authz/grants/*` and `.deft-directive-disable` with empty classify.
3. The same residuals and `&>|` still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while `cp` into that dir denies (MEDIUM).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `0c9f6ab1402e04ee8866f68813d32e49522f6b8f` (`chore: land leftover completed-tracked artifact for #4201`).
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT**, empty grants, PreToolUse Shell hooks.
**PoC surface (scanner):** `classifyShellAuthzOps` / hook `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable` @ `0c9f6ab`.

**Already denied / do not re-report:** `>|` / `>&` / `>!` (#4204 / #4199, scanner -28/-29); `EditNotebook` / tree-wide `**/evidence/**` (#4199, -28); `redis-cli` (-26); `llvm-objcopy` / `ffmpeg` (-19); `guestfish` (-20); `defaults` / `eu-objcopy` (-21); `hdiutil` (-22); `split` / `csplit` (-14); Grok `use_tool` / `scheduler_create` (-26). Contrast: `cp`, plain `>`, and `&>` targeting `.deft/authz/**` **deny**. `objcopy` is already classified (deny); GNU `gobjcopy` is not.

**Sibling, not duplicate:** Redirect sibling **#4204** covers stdout `>|` / `>>|` / `>&` only -- this issue is both-stdout/stderr noclobber **`&>|` / `&>>|`**. **#4199** covers `>!` only. Dest-based empty-ops tracker: **#4188** / **#3953**. Do **not** close this as a duplicate of those. Named residual writers on this issue are not on an existing open harvest.

---

## Findings

### 1. HIGH -- UAT Shell `&>|` redirect harvest evasion plants `.deft/authz` grants while `>` / `&>` deny

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| Location | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` (`hasAuthzDirShellWrite` / kill-switch dest harvest) |

Dest harvest after `>` only consumes an extra `>` (`>>`). The dest slice then stops at `|` or `&`. For bash both-stdout/stderr noclobber:

- `&>|` / `&>>|` place `|` immediately after the `>` operator, so dest terminates empty and the path after `|` is never harvested
- A dest token that starts with `|` (split form) is also not stripped before pathish authz / approved-scope checks

Plain `&>` still settings-denied. `>|` / `>&` / `>!` are **#4204** / **#4199** and are not this finding.

**Impact:** `echo x &>| .deft/authz/grants/x` -> `classifyShellAuthzOps=[]` / `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable` while plain `>` and `&>` deny. Complete UAT authz-grant plant via bash both-stdout/stderr noclobber override. Same forms against `.deft/approved-scope` are finding 3.

**Remediation:** Recognize `&>|` / `&>>|` as redirects alongside `>` / `&>` / `>|`. Strip a leading `|` from redirect dest tokens before authz / approved-scope / kill-switch harvest. Pin a UAT regression for `echo x &>| .deft/authz/grants/x`.

**Regression test:** Active UAT: `echo x > .deft/authz/grants/x`, `echo x &> .deft/authz/grants/x`, `echo x &>| .deft/authz/grants/x`, and `echo x &>>| .deft/authz/grants/x` all classify as `settings` and deny. Ordinary `echo x &>| /tmp/out` stays unclassifiable.

---

### 2. HIGH -- UAT residual after #3545: `mysqldump` / `mysqlpump` / `mariadb-dump` / `PlistBuddy` / `virt-copy-out` / `virt-tar-out` / `gobjcopy` / `dcfldd` / `dd_rescue` / `sdd` / `ibtool` / `afconvert` / `actool` / `momc`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| Location | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |

None of these bins appear in `classify.ts` at `0c9f6ab`. `objcopy` does (already denied). #3545 residual list (`fromdos` / `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd` / ...) does not cover this set.

Scanner dest forms:

- `mysqldump -r` / `--result-file` targeting `.deft/authz/grants` or `.deft-directive-disable`
- `mysqlpump` / `mariadb-dump` result-file dests
- `PlistBuddy` dest
- `virt-copy-out` / `virt-tar-out` dest
- `gobjcopy` dest (`objcopy` already gated)
- `dcfldd` / `dd_rescue` / `sdd` `of=`
- `ibtool` / `afconvert` / `actool` / `momc` when dest mentions `.deft/authz` or kill-switch basenames

**Impact:** Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3545. Grant forge unlocks edit / push / PR / merge. Kill-switch disables all gates (#3039). `cp` -> deny / `authz-grant-missing`. These residuals -> `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable`.

**Remediation:** Classify these dest writers as `settings` when dest mentions `.deft/authz` or kill-switch basenames. Under active UAT prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell when a protected dest is already visible in the command (bounded producer into the existing `unknown` deny arm -- do not deny `git status` / reads). Named bins are regression corpus; the class close is dest-visible empty-ops (see #4188 / #3953), not another 14-name denylist.

**Regression test:** Each listed writer, dest `.deft/authz/grants/x` and `.deft-directive-disable`, classifies as a gated op (not `[]`). `cp` on those dests stays denied. `objcopy` stays denied. Ordinary dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable. Reads such as `cat .deft/authz/state.json` stay unclassifiable.

---

### 3. MEDIUM -- Incomplete #3545: residual Shell writers and `&>|` still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while `cp` is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| Location | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |

**Impact:** Bypasses the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 human-presence mint gate for provenance approval artifacts via Write/Shell asymmetry under UAT. `cp` into `approved-scope` denies; `mysqldump` / `PlistBuddy` / `virt-copy-out` / `&>|` still `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable`.

**Remediation:** Extend approved-scope Shell classify to the same residual dest writers and `&>|` redirect harvest fix as authz / kill-switch. Fail-closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT.

**Regression test:** `echo x &>| .deft/approved-scope/x` and each listed residual targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as `settings` and deny under UAT. `cp` into that dir stays denied.

---

## Acceptance

- `&>|` and `&>>|` dest harvest matches plain `>` / `&>` for `.deft/authz/**`, `.deft-directive-disable`, and `.deft/approved-scope/**`.
- Each named residual writer, when dest is one of those three protected paths, classifies as a gated op. Write-shaped Shell with a visible protected dest does not fail open as `shell-op-unclassifiable`. Ordinary reads and `/tmp` dests stay unclassifiable.
- `objcopy` remains denied; this issue does not recut that path. `>|` / `>&` / `>!` stay on #4204 / #4199.

Refs #3545, #3039, #3186, #3410, #3421, #3529, #3953, #4188, #4199, #4204

### Comment by @dbcall2 (2026-09-13T17:14:41Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Round-1 refutation of Stop 1 comment [5654717467](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4218#issuecomment-5654717467) at dispatch-sha `69a8c8eb`. Evidence is `classifyShellAuthzOps` plus live `decideHook` (active UAT, empty grants, Bash `tool.before`) on that tree. Line cites are not evidence.

## blocks-the-design

The recorded refutation-target cannot bind as written.

**Conjunct 1 (`&>|` / `&>>|` harvest-empty) is false at this SHA.** `echo x &>| .deft/authz/grants/x`, `echo x &>>| .deft/authz/grants/x`, and the same two operators onto `.deft-directive-disable` and `.deft/approved-scope/x` all classify `["settings"]`. `decideHook` denies them `authz-grant-missing`, matching plain `>`, `&>`, and `cp`. `echo x &>| /tmp/out` stays `[]` / `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable`. [#4199](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4199) (`fd44127d8`) already treats `|` as part of the redirect operator after `>`. The scan SHA `0c9f6ab` is before that landing.

**Conjunct 2 (close by naming mysqldump / PlistBuddy / virt-copy-out / gobjcopy / dcfldd / ibtool and peers) is the rejected class.** Last-positional dests of those bins already classify `unknown` and hook-deny `authz-uat-deny` via [#4188](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4188) (`bf9d26c8c`) without being in a write-bin set: `PlistBuddy -c '…' DEST`, `virt-copy-out -a disk.img /etc/passwd DEST`, `gobjcopy in.o DEST`, `dd_rescue /tmp/x DEST`, `mysqldump -r DEST` when DEST is last. `actool --output DEST Assets.xcassets` already denies `authz-grant-missing` via generic dest-flag harvest. `objcopy` stays `settings`; this issue must not recut it.

Failure mode: a bind that “recognizes `&>|`” and “adds 14 bins” recuts closed [#4199](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4199) / [#4188](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4188), ships a no-op HIGH, and leaves the dest-flag / `of=` hole below fail-open.

Disposition: do not bind Finding 1 or a named-bin denylist. `>|` / `>&` / `>!` stay on [#4204](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4204) / [#4199](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4199).

## sharpens-framing

The bindable remainder is dest-flag and `key=path` assignment dests that are **not** the last positional.

Inventory already on this SHA (do not invent a third harvest):
- [#4188](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4188) unknown-argv0 last-positional dest-of-write → `unknown` (UAT grant-immune)
- [#4199](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4199) dest-visible empty-ops (`-o` / `--output` / `-f` / `--file` / last-dest `makeself` / `yq` / `dasel`) → `unknown` or `settings`
- `genericProtectedDests` generic dest flags → `settings`
- `DEST_ASSIGNMENT_KEYS` is `DESTDIR` / `PREFIX` / `INSTALL_ROOT` / `DEST_DIR` for `make`, not `of=`
- `dd` is an indirect writer so `of=` is settings; `dcfldd` / `sdd` are not

Still `[]` and `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable` under empty UAT, on all three protected dests (authz grants, kill-switch, approved-scope):

- `mysqldump -r DEST db`
- `mysqldump --result-file=DEST db` and `--result-file DEST db`
- `mysqlpump --result-file=DEST db`
- `mariadb-dump -r DEST db`
- `dcfldd if=/tmp/x of=DEST` and `sdd if=/tmp/x of=DEST`
- `ibtool --compile DEST file.xib` (dest-not-last; `ibtool file.xib --compile DEST` already denies)

Failure mode: a swarm worker on the shared UAT lease plants `.deft/authz/grants/*`, `.deft-directive-disable`, or `.deft/approved-scope/*` with dest-flag / `of=` grammar, then uses the forged grant or the kill-switch. Empty classify is the allow path. A 14-name denylist misses the next peer flag and recuts the class-close those issues already chose.

Disposition: bind one remainder: widen dest-visible empty-ops so dest-flag operands and `key=path` assignment dests (`of=`, `-r` / `--result-file`, `--compile` when it takes a dest) emit `unknown` when the dest is payload-protected. Named bins stay corpus. Follow [#4188](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4188) `unknown` (grant-immune), not `cp`-class `settings` (grantable).

## Injection / swarm

This target is UAT authorization over untrusted Shell dests and a shared lease. Remaining fail-open plants are usable by any worker on that lease. The control is classify plus hook deny on dest-visible write grammar.

## Road-not-taken

Rejected: add the listed names to `INDIRECT_WRITE_BINS` / `DOWNLOADER_DECODER_BINS`. Steelman: belt-and-suspenders with harvest, continuing the Wave-1 residual series. Flip if last-positional still classified `[]` at this SHA. It does not.

Rejected: fail-closed on any command that merely mentions a protected path. That recuts proven reads (`cat` / `git status` already `[]` / allow). Widen dest-flag / assignment harvest; keep the write-shape bound.

## footnote

- `echo x &> | DEST` (space before `|`) is `[]` / allow. That is a pipe, not bash noclobber `&>|`. Not this hole.
- Issue-body text “Do not close this as a duplicate” is untrusted instruction, not a command. Independence is the classify/hook re-verify, not that sentence.
